For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Onsite CAMC of EPABX system installed at CSACS is required. 2. The service provider whom the contract is awarded will have to submit5% of contract value as performa nce security to CSACS bank details will be shared with the service provided at the time of selection. 3. The CAMC provider will carry out all necessary repair and servicing of the equipment installed at CSACS office on site. 4. The CAMC provider shall replace free of cost all unserviceable/defective spares/components and telepho ne sets during AMC period. 5. Service:-24 x 7 services -Services for the EPABX system has to be rendered on 24 x 7 basis. Bidder shall be available to attend the fault, as on need basis, irrespective of the odd hours or holidays. 6. Care of Equipment: -The bidder will take care of the equipment by the means of regular monthly visits & maintenance on monthly basis. The repair or replacement which may be necessitated due to any fault duri ng CAMC will be done by the bidder on free of cost. 7. Responsibilities & Response time on complaints: -Services for the EPABX system will be rendered on 24 x 7 basis. Engineer/ technician of firm shall be available to attend the faults, on need basis, irrespective of the odd hours or holidays. During holidays/ odd hours, the firm's technical representative shall reach the si te within 02 (two) hours notice. 8. No advance shall be paid towards CAMC charges. The CAMC charges shall be paid in quarterly installme

nts after satisfactory service report of each quarter (of all Officer/Officials of CSACS) with the bill for CAMC service for quarter. 9. In case of services rendered not found satisfactory, CSACS reserves the right to terminate the contract a nd to forfeit the performance security submitted. 10. Safety of Men:-The Vendor is to ensure adequate safeguards for personnel when employed on work wh ere human risk of health/ injury is involved. CSACS will not responsible for any casualty suffered by the sta ff deputed for maintenance work. 11. The character and antecedents of engineers/technician to be deputed in SPG to look after comprehensi ve AMC should be verified by Police before their deployment. 12. Bidder must visit Chandigarh State AIDS Control society Sec-15 Chandigarh for inspection of the curren tly installed EPABX System (model and working status), during any working day i.e Mon-Fri 10:00 AM to 04: 00 PM. Contact No for visit 9781320008 .
